text:
sam_devex: heads up — support report: duplicate items created during onboarding when SDK retried after 429 on a batched request. customer used node quickstart defaults.

olga_support: customer says payload was batched, response had per-item statuses but top-level 200. SDK saw 200 and later retried failed items -> duplicates.

marina_platform: ah, so partial success inside a 200. thats rough. api should be explicit for batch semantics.

josh_sdk: current SDK retry logic is purely status-code driven. if we get a 200 we don't retry. but in this case we later got 429s for subitems? need details.

olga_support: flow: client POST batch -> server responds 200 with item_statuses: [ok, 429]. SDK treated as success, but sampleapp had follow-up reconciliation that retried the 429 ones without idempotency keys, which reprocessed earlier ok items.

kevin_api: we can add top-level meta: item_statuses + retriable boolean per item, and optional server_op_id for dedupe. i'll put a proposal in API PR.

priya_sre: server_op_id dedupe window is important. also recommend default backoff: base=100ms, cap=30s, full jitter to avoid thundering herd.

josh_sdk: proposal for SDK: add opt-in flag safeBatchReplay: when true, SDK will parse item_statuses and only retry those with retriable=true, and emit a metric when it sees mixed results. default keep current behaviour to avoid breaking clients.

sam_devex: quickstart change: show per-batch Idempotency-Key header + client_item_id inside items. tiny snippet so customers copy the safe pattern.

olga_support: i'll tell affected customer to set Idempotency-Key and client_item_ids for now.

ci-bot: deploy queued: docs/batch-idempotency-guidance -> staging

marina_platform: action items: API: add item_statuses + retriable + server_op_id (kevin). SDK: implement safeBatchReplay opt-in + metrics (josh). Docs: quickstart snippet update (sam). Support: notify customer & workaround (olga). SRE: propose dedupe window (priya).

josh_sdk: will open node + python PRs. small migration note: if server starts returning item_statuses, SDK will surface them to caller when safeBatchReplay=true.

sam_devex: thanks all. if anyone wants an RFC i'll draft one tomorrow. :thumbsup:
